poses.description: Sit with legs wide. Grip your left foot and bring it toward your ear like you're holding a phone.
Spread your legs wide and raise your arms. Imagine you're a dancing monkey full of energy!
Stand with legs wide apart. Bend your knees and spread your arms like a cowboy on a horse.
Lunge forward with one leg. Raise your arms and roar like a mighty dinosaur!
On your hands and knees. Arch your back and look up like a friendly cow.
